The registration of `rb_column` as a floating object in `rb-grn-table.c` ensures that it is tracked properly, while the unregistration of `rb_accessor` in `rb-grn-accessor.c` ensures that it is cleaned up correctly when it is no longer needed.
- The modification in `rb-grn-context.c` complements the changes in the other two files by altering how floating objects are closed, ensuring that the cleanup process is handled through Ruby's method calls rather than direct object manipulation.
